changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.22[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes: lists from Trakt[/COLOR]
-Different shows no longer appear as the same one. On some devices a Trending page showed one show eight or nine times, such as Tracker or Friday the 13th: Crystal Lake. Each title now only takes its own saved details.
-A movie and a show with the same TMDb number no longer mix their details.
-Saved details that belong to another title are removed when they are found, and the title is fetched again. Nothing has to be cleared by hand.
-Every page is full again: Trending and Popular show 20 titles per page, or the number set in Settings, and Recommended shows its 40.
-Trending, TV shows and Movies: a title is listed once and never comes back on a later page, even when Trakt sends it more than once. Titles keep Trakt's order.
-Lists of TV shows and movies from Trakt, SIMKL, PunchPlay and WeTrakr show each title once. Trakt history is left as it is: a movie you watched twice still shows twice.
